title: Switch & segmented control
notes: The `switch` attribute keeps a checkbox as a checkbox, form submission and all, while exposing switch semantics to assistive tech instead of the usual `role="switch"` markup. `appearance: none` and `:checked` give it one look across browsers, supported or not.

The billing control is a real radio group; its sliding thumb is one `::before` moved with `:has(#id:checked)`, no JavaScript. Only Safari implements `switch` today; elsewhere it renders as a plain checkbox, which this demo styles identically either way.
